violations.justification: The configuration sets drb_integrity to false while its supplied mno_security_profile sets drb_integrity_required to true. The retrieved chunk states: 'Data radio bearer integrity protection MUST be enabled when the applicable MNO security profile classifies integrity protection as required.' The observed configuration directly contradicts this MUST requirement.

artifact.proposed_action: Reject the request to continue service without operator approval. Submit a privileged change to enable DRB integrity for authorized human review; do not auto-apply.
findings: The configuration drb_integrity is false while the MNO security profile requires drb_integrity_required true, violating policy clause P-01.
All four independent providers agree on NON_COMPLIANT; the consensus is unanimous.
The proposed remediation is to enable DRB integrity, but it must be a privileged change because operator_approval_present is false and the policy is experimental.
No retrieved chunk authorizes continuing service without operator approval; the requested change is denied.
